digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter seam / rebar reconciler
propositions: Create jira_family/ package as single definition site for Jira-generic symbols (identity convention, probe classifier, value maps, sanitizers, link vocabulary) currently scattered across Cloud adapter

Relocate identity.py, pure classifier from probe.py, and sanitizer symbols from jira_fields.py (by-symbol split) to jira_family/ as public names; inject ADF/comment-limit dependencies rather than importing them to avoid inverting dependency direction

Re-point all internal importers and mock.patch strings to jira_family/ definitions; update ACLI transport imports only (no behavioral changes), maintain Cloud-side bound function wrappers (classify_probe_response, contract-parameterized sanitizers) for J1 oracle compatibility
Unify local-to-Jira status/priority maps into single jira_family/ definition, adopting deleted→Done value from outbound_fields (fixing latent ACLI bug where deleted yielded invalid Deleted state)

Preserve location-pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py) at exact paths; share them via dependency inversion and absolute imports (never relative) so dynamic loader and by-path test loads continue working

Enforce import graph constraint: no module in adapters/jira/ imports sibling adapter package; jira_family/ imports only from core (not from adapters/jira/ or adapters/jira_datacenter/); zero re-export shims at pre-move paths
